about: Every record that changed in the held-totals step (data/local/REPORT.md section 31; the orchestrator's orders of 2026-11-07 17:44, 18:49, 20:28, 20:30, 20:55, 21:03 and 21:21), against bcd1ce9 (main 9118755 merged), the code of this step aside. Each group, with its reason:

groups.OR 2024 Supreme Court: Position 7 takes the Secretary of State's abstract total (gate passed; mark: the records system's title '... Official Results'), so p is computed (0: one name, write-ins against) and it is typed a statewide judge; Position 1 stays held, its reason now naming the abstract's failed gate (Misc.: county lines 26,078, Total line 26,077)
groups.AZ 2022 Attorney General: marked 'count before the recount, certified count unread' (result.count_stage, a note); the Clerk's copy refused and a third party's copy ruled out (21:03)
groups.AZ 2024 Corporation Commissioner: one contest of 3 seats (M2's sixth pass (a)); still not computed, now for too few like races of its class
groups.the over-ballot test (17:44): MI 2018 and OH 2018 Supreme Court, HI 2022 trustee and MI 2022 Attorney General stay held, their reasons restated against the day's top contest; TX 2024 Supreme Court is held (32,783,005 votes, 2.87 times the president's: three seats filed as one; it had no p); IL 2018 Secretary of State and DE 2022 Attorney General are listed between 1.0 and 1.1 times, with a note
groups.listed rows (20:28): 27 records gain 'a possible total row in the source, not dropped' (a row moving its record by more than 0.5%); data/local/check-listed-rows.json lists every row
groups.M2 (b) recall answers: Idaho 2024's Latah County and Marsh Valley School District recalls: each 'AGAINST RECALLING' line, filed as a candidate's, joins its question; the two local records are gone and the two questions carry both answers (still no p: local threshold unread)
groups.M2 (c) North Carolina 2008 and 2010 Cour: typed judge, not statewide judge: no seat count of one in the title or the State Board's file (18:13); p stays 0
groups.M2 (d) the 'Town of' guard: five 2024 questions of NY and RI no longer counted whole by the town (the title names another body after the town's name); now counted by county, still no p
groups.VA 2023 and 2025 legislatures: the gate's RULED text (18:49) on every record, and 'not explained' on the shortfall notes
groups.c38 (21:21): VT 2018 Chittenden Senate takes MEDSL's counts (Klarner's 2.78 to 3.83 times them): p moves x3.49; ID 2022 Senate 1 adds Steven R Johnson, a write-in of 9,025 votes by the state's canvass: p 0 is no longer computed (the write-in rule)

codes.G: a record no longer written (joined into another, or replaced)
codes.R: not computed before or after, the reason changed
